verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly supports iterative refinement via natural-language follow-up prompts ('Describe what you want... AI updates code, styles, and components for you', 'AI shows previews before it touches anything'), and GitHub sync plus a built-in DB architecture help preserve app integrity across edits (praised by a community reviewer for making cross-app fixes easy). However, there's no documented rollback/checkpoint/versioning safety net specifically guarding against regressions from new prompts, and one community post complains about runaway token costs when iteration goes wrong. Missing for 10: explicit undo/checkpoint or diff-preview mechanism guaranteeing non-breaking changes, and independent hands-on evidence that repeated prompt iterations don't degrade existing features.
